methodology.success: Only associated trials whose live reward is exactly 1.
methodology.repair: Added plus deleted scoped source against the packaged baseline.
methodology.loc: Nonblank physical lines containing a non-comment Pygments token.
methodology.code_bytes: UTF-8 bytes in non-comment, non-whitespace lexer tokens.
methodology.code_tokens: Non-comment, non-whitespace source-code lexical tokens counted by Pygments; these are not model or API tokens.
methodology.comment_density: Comment words per 100 final-side lexical tokens; docstrings count as comments.
methodology.ari_grade: Automated Readability Index grade of comment prose, using characters per word and words per sentence.
methodology.flesch_reading_ease: Flesch Reading Ease of comment prose; higher is easier. English syllables use a documented vowel-group heuristic.
methodology.readability_eligibility: At least 100 English prose words and 5 punctuated sentences per artifact. Repair tasks use final-side comments on changed lines.
methodology.complexity: Final scoped source for greenfield; final touched files for repair. Mozilla rust-code-analysis 0.0.25; unsupported languages are null.
methodology.failures: Failures count toward solve rate and have no source metric.
methodology.normalization: Each task-relative index sets the lowest successful model mean to 100.

tools.readability: internal deterministic formulas; syllable heuristic v1
